title: Quiet Mahjong
subtitle: Find a pair. Make a little space.
instructions: Match two available tiles with the same face.
A tile is available if no tile covers it and its left or right side is open.
Select a tile. Then select its matching tile to remove the pair.
Select the same tile again to clear your selection.
Use Hint to highlight an available pair. A hint does not guarantee a winning path.
Use Undo to restore the last pair. You can undo every match.
Restart restores this deal. New game creates a different deal.
Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus. Use Enter or Space to select a tile.
playing: Find two matching tiles with an open side.
hintShown: The outlined tiles form an available pair.
wonTitle: A clear board. A quiet mind.
won: You matched every tile. Start a new game, or enjoy the pause.
deadEnd: Undo a match, restart this deal, or start a new game.
confirmRestart: Restart this deal? This removes your current progress.
confirmNewGame: Start a new game? This removes your current progress.
footer: No clock. No score. Just one pair at a time.
instructionsNote: Every new deal has a solution. Your choices can lead to a dead end.
